chat_evaluation.notes: A kb chat session was started against the baseline base, but the conversational transcript was not harvested into this artifact. Query evaluation is complete; chat evaluation remains a follow-up.

qualitative_findings: The baseline init run completed successfully end to end, so the core interactive workflow is operational.
The resulting KB was extremely shallow: 1 document and an empty graph.
The surviving document answered only the broadest project-overview question well.
The main failure mode was topic collapse: architecture, workflow, policy, and command detail were not preserved as separate retrieval units.
This artifact is still useful as a lower-bound baseline for future comparison runs and ticket-driven improvements.
next_improvement_areas: Broaden init source discovery beyond the current narrow markdown shortlist.
Add doc-count and graph-population assertions to evaluation gates.
Reduce over-consolidation by preserving a minimum number of topic-separated documents.
Capture chat transcripts automatically into future evaluation artifacts.
